# listmonk_user_role (Data Source)

Looks up a listmonk user role by exact name, e.g. the built-in `Super Admin`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "listmonk_user_role" "super_admin" {
  name = "Super Admin"
}

resource "listmonk_user" "admin" {
  username     = "ops"
  email        = "ops@example.com"
  user_role_id = data.listmonk_user_role.super_admin.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the role.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the role.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Permissions of the role. Empty for Super Admin, which has every permission implicitly.
